questions.question: In 2024, an 18-year-old Indian named D. Gukesh became the youngest ever World Champion in which game?
questions.funFact: D. Gukesh, from Chennai, became the youngest World Chess Champion in history.

questions.question: India's star athlete who won an Olympic gold medal in the javelin throw is ___.
questions.funFact: A javelin is a long spear that athletes throw as far as they can.

questions.question: In 2026, India won the Men's T20 Cricket World Cup for the third time.
questions.funFact: India had also won the very first Men's T20 World Cup back in 2007.

questions.question: ISRO's space mission sent to study the Sun is called ___.
questions.funFact: 'Aditya' is a Sanskrit word for the Sun, which is exactly what this spacecraft studies.

questions.question: At the 2024 Paris Olympics, shooter Manu ___ became the first Indian to win two medals at a single Olympic Games.
questions.funFact: Manu Bhaker won her two medals in shooting events at the Paris Olympics.

questions.question: The RCB cricket team, led by stars like Virat Kohli, won the IPL in both 2025 and ___.
questions.funFact: Winning two years in a row is called winning 'back-to-back' titles.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a space agency?
questions.funFact: FIFA runs world football; ISRO (India), NASA (USA) and JAXA (Japan) are all space agencies.

questions.question: Chandrayaan-3 was India's successful mission to land on the Moon.
questions.funFact: Chandrayaan-3 carried a small rover named 'Pragyan' that rolled around and explored the Moon's surface.

questions.question: P. V. Sindhu is a famous Indian champion in which sport?
questions.funFact: P. V. Sindhu has won Olympic medals in badminton, making the whole country proud.

questions.question: The USA's space programme to send astronauts back to the Moon is called ___.
questions.funFact: The Artemis programme aims to land the first woman on the Moon.

questions.question: The world chess champion D. Gukesh is from India.
questions.funFact: The game of chess itself is believed to have been invented in ancient India, long ago.

questions.question: The WPL, a popular sports league in India that started in 2023, is a league for women in which sport?
questions.funFact: WPL stands for the Women's Premier League, giving India's best women cricketers a big stage to shine.
